part: 0201 (0603 metric, 0.6 x 0.3 mm) RC0201/NCP03 chip resistor / NTC
datasheet: Murata JEMCG0-2701K 'Soldering and Mounting / (2) Land Dimensions', Table 2 Reflow Soldering Method (a = gap between lands, b = land length, c = land width), printed in every GRM spec sheet, here GRM21BR71C106KE51L spec p32 (LCSC C408142, p23/merge/od/dl/murata/grm21_c408142.pdf)
derivation: GR*03 row: a 0.20-0.30, b 0.20-0.35, c 0.20-0.40. Chosen a 0.20 (= the chip's minimum terminal gap g 0.2), b 0.35, c 0.40 (range maxima): lands 0.35 x 0.40 at +-0.275 (0.90 x 0.40 overall) so a 0.35 mm filled+capped via fits inside a pad (D23 via-in-pad plan). Budget envelope 0.8 x 0.35 is exceeded by 0.10 x 0.05 on purpose; the P2 preview placed the larger stock land (1.10 x 0.40). Same land for every 0201 chip on the BOM (resistors, NTC, ferrite, inductor share the 0.6 x 0.3 format; Yageo RC0201 publishes no land). Corrected copy of the OpenDrone/KiCad-stock land (0.46 x 0.40 at +-0.32 plus paste-only pads).
